verdict.rationale: SumUp documents an official managed MCP server at https://mcp.sumup.com/mcp that lets MCP clients and AI assistants use SumUp APIs to manage accounts, create checkouts and process payments, and a probe confirms the MCP server docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent to the server, and documented auth and setup details for the connection in the evidence pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: SumUp runs a managed MCP server at https://mcp.sumup.com/mcp. This endpoint allows your MCP client to interact with SumUp APIs to manage your account, create checkouts, or process payments using Cloud API.
Use the SumUp MCP server to connect MCP-compatible clients and AI assistants to SumUp APIs and documentation tools.
